description: JWT signature and claims verification — Verifies a JWS-compact JWT: signature over `base64url(header).base64url(payload)` with Web Crypto under the exact algorithm in the token's `alg` header (HS256/384/512, RS256/384/512, PS256/384/512, ES256/384/512, EdDSA). Refuses 'none' unconditionally and rejects any alg not in the caller's allowedAlgorithms. Validates exp/nbf with a configurable clock-skew tolerance (default 60s), iss equality, a

allowedAlgorithms.description: Algorithms the caller accepts; verification fails if the header's alg is not here.

value.description: The key material: a string for hmac-secret and pem-spki, a JWK object for jwk.

token.description: The JWS-compact JWT: three base64url parts joined by '.'.

name: jwt-verify
